# Marais Consulting

> Marais Consulting is a Brisbane-based technology, AI and cyber advisory firm founded in 2017 by Sanja Marais. It partners with boards, executive teams and technology leaders to design, govern and deliver complex transformation across digital, AI, cyber security and enterprise technology, with deep experience in healthcare, defence, government and other regulated environments. Based in Brisbane, Queensland, Australia, and advising clients globally.

## About Sanja Marais

Full profile: [About Sanja Marais](https://maraisconsulting.com.au/about/)

- Founder and Principal Consultant of Marais Consulting. Technology, security and AI executive with 25+ years of enterprise technology leadership and 16+ years in healthcare.
- Trained organisational psychologist; co-founded and ran operations, finance, HR, training and IT for a South African security company that grew from six people to 750.
- Previous employers include Medibank Health Solutions (Defence health contracts) and Aspen Medical, where she was Chief Technology & Security Officer and founding CEO of Aspen Medical Technology.
- Led global ISO 27001:2022 certification end to end, and an IRAP assessment.
- Co-designed and led development of a national platform for a Federal Government COVID-19 program that supported more than 6.8 million patient visits.
- Supported a $3.1B government contract with technology and cyber security.
- Credentials: ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, ISO 42001 Implementer, PRINCE2 Foundation; Master of Commerce, University of Pretoria. Member of Women in Digital.
- Regular speaker, panellist and host at CIO, CISO, cyber security and transformation conferences; moderates CIO summits across Australia, Singapore and Malaysia.
- Certified image consultant who helps women elevate their personal style and confidence.

## Services

- [Digital Transformation & Architecture](https://maraisconsulting.com.au/services/): enterprise technology strategy, roadmaps, operating model design, cloud-first infrastructure, enterprise architecture, RFP support and vendor negotiation, digital product development, national-scale platform delivery, UX prototyping, and technical due diligence for M&A.
- [Cyber Governance & Compliance](https://maraisconsulting.com.au/services/): ISO 27001:2022 certification and audit leadership, IRAP assessment support, DISP security officer support, Essential Eight, NIST CSF 2.0 and GDPR alignment, security-by-design and privacy frameworks, board-level cyber risk reporting, control uplift, and cyber due diligence for M&A.
- [AI Enablement & Innovation](https://maraisconsulting.com.au/services/): enterprise AI roadmap design, responsible AI adoption, ISO 42001-aligned AI advisory, automation strategy, AI-enabled operating models, digital venture creation and product commercialisation.
- [Executive Advisory](https://maraisconsulting.com.au/services/): fractional CTO, CIO and CISO support, board technology advisory, C-suite advisory, conference speaking and chairing, executive facilitation, transformation governance and investment assurance.

## Sectors

Healthcare, defence, government, financial services and corporate enterprise.
